messages:
Devon: quick sync — we need a concrete plan for implementing a canary gate that combines runtime and infra signals. focus on p99 delta, error-rate regressions, and queue/backpressure. who owns the composite?

Mira: runtime can emit p99_delta and model error_delta per route. infra owns queue_depth and scheduler lag. product wants a single pass/fail "gate" visible in Console.

Carl: i made a small grafana prototype that z-normalizes signals and sums weighted scores. good for offline; for auto-rollback we need near-realtime (<30s) evaluation.

Anya: realtime means minimal cross-joins in promql. can we push precomputed deltas from producers and have the metrics-router emit a single rollout_score metric? cheaper than joining multiple series live.

Sree: agree. ingest-side compute looks sensible. runtime posts p99_delta and err_delta as short-lived metrics; infra posts queue_ratio. router computes: rollout_score = 0.5*p99_z + 0.35*err_z + 0.15*queue_z. weights should be configurable per product/route.

Mira: we also need both per-route and global rollout gates. per-route should show side-by-side control vs canary, the gate_score, and the dominant signal that pushed the score. Console needs a compact sparkline for the last 5 minutes.

Devon: UX ask: on rollout page show: (1) control vs canary comparison panel, (2) gate_score number & trend, (3) top contributor, (4) quick action buttons (hold/continue/rollback). who owns the API for the UI?

Carl: Console should own the UI, runtime/infra must expose a stable small API. proposal: GET /v1/rollout_signals?route=<route>&window=30s returns JSON list of {score, contributors:[{name,value,z}], raw:{p99_delta,err_delta,queue_ratio}}. keep payload compact.

Anya: naming bikeshed: rollout_signals vs canary_clock vs health_gate. i prefer rollout_signals. include optional history param to fetch last N windows. return as newline-delimited JSON if we expect many rows.

infra-bot: deploy: metrics-router v2 deployed to staging with /v1/rollout_signals. p95 export latency 48ms. :white_check_mark:

Sree: need to formalize alerting contract: if score > threshold for 3 consecutive windows -> create alert. automation (auto-rollback) must be opt-in per deployment. alerts should include dominant signal and a few trace ids (sampled) for debugging.

Mira: +1. also require a minimum volume filter so noisy low-traffic routes don't trigger gates. include a volume_ok boolean in API.

Devon: action items:
- infra: add rollout_signals endpoint and include contributors + raw metrics (p99_delta, err_delta, queue_ratio) — Sree
- runtime: emit p99_delta and err_delta per route/model with consistent labels — Mira
- console: wire UI to /v1/rollout_signals, show dominant signal and action buttons, surface volume_ok — Carl & Anya

Anya: can someone paste a promql example for p99_delta so i can demo on staging?

Carl: example promql: (quantile_over_time(0.99, latency_seconds{env="canary",route=~"/chat.*"}[1m]) - quantile_over_time(0.99, latency_seconds{env="control",route=~"/chat.*"}[1m])) / quantile_over_time(0.99, latency_seconds{env="control",route=~"/chat.*"}[1m])

Devon: great. i'll write a short RFC that includes the API contract, weight defaults, opt-in automation rules, and alerting thresholds. 30-min sync tomorrow to sign off. thanks all :thumbsup:
